recipes.name: Butter Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken with ginger-garlic paste, chilli powder and salt for 15–20 min, then pan-fry and set aside.
Cook onions in butter, add tomatoes and cashews; add garlic, vinegar, sugar, garam masala and chilli powder, simmer 15–20 min.
Churn to a fine purée and strain back into the pan — minimal wastage.
Add butter, cream, chicken and kasuri methi; simmer 5–7 min. Garnish with cream. Serves 4–5.

recipes.name: Afghani Chicken
steps: Toast fenugreek 30–60 sec till crisp; cool.
Mix curd, cream, ginger-garlic paste, garam masala, chaat masala, fenugreek, salt and lemon into a creamy marinade; coat the chicken.
Smoke-infuse: place burning charcoal in a bowl inside the marinade, add oil, cover immediately.
Pan-cook on moderate flame, flipping; add remaining marinade, then water; cover 10–12 min on low. Baste and garnish with chillies, lemon, mint.

recipes.name: Chicken Biryani
steps: Marinate chicken in curd, masala and ginger-garlic 1 hr.
Par-boil rice with whole spices to 70%.
Layer chicken, rice, birista, mint; top with saffron milk.
Dum on low 25 min. Rest 10 min before opening.

recipes.name: Tandoori Chicken
steps: Slash chicken; first marinade of lemon, salt, chilli 20 min.
Second marinade of hung curd + masala, 2 hrs.
Roast at 220°C / grill ~25 min, basting with butter.
Finish with chaat masala and lemon.

recipes.name: Chicken 65
steps: Marinate chicken with curd, egg, corn flour, chilli and ginger-garlic 30 min.
Deep-fry till crisp and red.
Temper curry leaves, green chilli and garlic; toss the fried chicken through.

recipes.name: Grilled Chicken Salad
steps: Season and grill chicken 6–7 min a side; rest, then slice.
Whisk olive oil, lemon, mustard, honey, salt.
Toss greens, top with chicken, drizzle dressing.

recipes.name: Mutton Rogan Josh
steps: Sear mutton in ghee with whole spices.
Add chilli, fennel, dry ginger; stir in whisked curd.
Simmer covered 60–75 min till fork-tender; finish with garam masala.

recipes.name: Fish Curry
steps: Rub fish with turmeric-salt; shallow fry in mustard oil.
Temper nigella; add tomato and mustard paste, simmer.
Slide fish in, 8–10 min with green chillies.

recipes.name: Prawn Masala
steps: Sauté onions till golden; add tomato + masalas.
Add prawns, cook just 5–6 min.
Finish with coconut and curry leaves.

recipes.name: Anda Bhurji
steps: Sauté onion, chilli, tomato with pav bhaji masala.
Crack in eggs, scramble on high till just set.
Butter-toast pav; serve topped with coriander.

recipes.name: Egg Curry
steps: Fry boiled eggs till blistered; set aside.
Cook onion-tomato masala till oil separates.
Add water, simmer; slide eggs in for 5 min.

recipes.name: Paneer Butter Masala
steps: Simmer tomatoes + cashews; blend silky.
Cook purée in butter with chilli + garam masala.
Add paneer, cream, kasuri methi; 5 min.

recipes.name: Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch spinach 2 min, ice-bath, blend.
Sauté garlic-onion; add purée and spices.
Add paneer cubes and cream; simmer 5 min.

recipes.name: Dal Tadka + Jeera Rice
steps: Pressure-cook dal with turmeric.
Tadka: ghee, jeera, garlic, chilli, tomato — pour over.
Steam rice with jeera; serve together.

recipes.name: Chole Bhature
steps: Soak chole overnight; cook with tea bag till dark and soft.
Simmer in onion-tomato masala with anardana.
Knead maida-curd dough, rest 2 hrs; roll and deep-fry bhature till puffed.

recipes.name: Rajma Chawal
steps: Soak rajma overnight; pressure-cook 5–6 whistles.
Slow-cook in onion-tomato-ginger masala 20 min.
Serve over steamed rice. Sunday feeling, any day.

recipes.name: Kadhi Chawal
steps: Whisk curd + besan + turmeric with water; simmer 20 min.
Add fried pakodis if feeling generous.
Tadka of ghee, methi seeds, red chilli; serve on rice.

recipes.name: Baingan Bharta
steps: Fire-roast baingan till collapsed; peel and mash.
Cook garlic-onion-tomato masala.
Fold in mash; cook 10 min till smoky.

recipes.name: Veg Biryani
steps: Marinate veg in curd + masala.
Par-boil rice; layer with veg, mint, birista.
Dum 20 min; rest before serving.

recipes.name: Masala Dosa
steps: Temper mustard, curry leaves; toss boiled potato masala.
Spread thin dosa on hot tawa, crisp with ghee.
Fill, fold, serve with sambar and chutney.

recipes.name: Idli Sambar
steps: Steam idlis 10–12 min.
Cook dal + veg + tamarind + sambar powder.
Tadka of mustard and curry leaves over sambar.

recipes.name: Aloo Gobi
steps: Sauté jeera, ginger; add potato first, then gobhi.
Turmeric, chilli, dhania powder; cover on low.
Finish with garam masala and coriander.

recipes.name: Bhindi Masala
steps: Dry bhindi completely; sauté on high till no slime.
Add onions, then masalas and amchur.
Toss with tomato 2 min — keep it crisp.

recipes.name: Moong Dal Khichdi
steps: Rinse dal + rice; pressure-cook soft with turmeric.
Ghee tadka of jeera (hing optional).
Serve loose with curd and papad. Comfort in a bowl.

recipes.name: Sabudana Khichdi
steps: Soak sabudana 4–5 hrs till fluffy.
Sauté jeera, chilli, potato in ghee.
Toss sabudana + crushed peanuts till pearls turn glassy. Vrat-friendly.

recipes.name: Pav Bhaji
steps: Boil and mash vegetables.
Cook in butter with masala till glossy; mash on tawa.
Butter-toast pav; serve with raw onion and lemon.

recipes.name: Samosa + Chai
steps: Stiff maida dough with ajwain; rest.
Spiced aloo-matar filling; fold cones and fill.
Fry low-and-slow till blistered. Brew kadak chai.

recipes.name: Pani Puri
steps: Blitz mint-coriander-chilli theeka pani; chill.
Sweet imli chutney; potato-chana filling.
Crack, fill, dunk, eat in one bite. Repeat.

recipes.name: Masala Maggi
steps: Sauté onion-tomato-veg in butter.
Add water + tastemaker + extra masala.
Noodles in for exactly 2 min. Slightly soupy > dry.

recipes.name: Chai + Pakora
steps: Thick besan batter with ajwain + chilli.
Dip onion/potato/paneer; fry till crackly.
Adrak-heavy chai. Best served with rain.

recipes.name: Paneer Tikka
steps: Thick marinade of hung curd + masala; coat paneer and veg 30 min.
Skewer; grill/air-fry 12–15 min till charred.
Chaat masala + lemon to finish.

recipes.name: Sprouts Chaat
steps: Steam sprouts 3–4 min (or keep raw).
Toss with chopped veg, peanuts, chaat masala, lemon.
Optional: pomegranate on top.

recipes.name: Oats Chilla
steps: Batter of oats + besan + veg + water; rest 10 min.
Spread on non-stick tawa; crisp both sides.
Serve with mint chutney or curd.

recipes.name: Soya Chunk Masala
steps: Boil chunks in salted water; squeeze dry.
Onion-tomato masala till oil separates.
Simmer chunks 10 min — protein of champions.

recipes.name: Quinoa Pulao
steps: Rinse quinoa well; toast in ghee with jeera.
Add veg + 2 cups water; cover 15 min.
Fluff, lemon, coriander.

recipes.name: Gulab Jamun
steps: Soft khoya-maida dough; smooth crack-free balls.
Fry on LOW till deep brown.
Rest in warm cardamom syrup 1 hr.

recipes.name: Gajar ka Halwa
steps: Grate carrots; cook down in milk till absorbed.
Bhuno in ghee till it darkens and smells nutty.
Sugar, khoya, cardamom; top with fried nuts.

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma Roll
steps: Marinate chicken in curd + shawarma spices; pan-roast and slice.
Warm pita; spread garlic sauce.
Roll with chicken + pickles; toast seam-side down.

recipes.name: Margherita Pizza
steps: Stretch dough thin; spread crushed tomato and salt.
Tear over mozzarella; bake as hot as your oven goes (~250°C) till blistered.
Finish with basil and olive oil.

recipes.name: Pasta Alfredo
steps: Boil pasta al dente; save pasta water.
Melt butter + garlic; add cream and parmesan.
Toss pasta through, loosen with pasta water. Black pepper to finish.

recipes.name: Chicken Pesto Panini
steps: Spread pesto on ciabatta; layer chicken, cheese, tomato.
Press in a hot panini grill till crisp and melty.
Slice on the diagonal.

recipes.name: Thai Green Curry
steps: Fry curry paste in a little coconut cream till fragrant.
Add chicken, then coconut milk and fish sauce; simmer 15 min.
Add veg and Thai basil; serve with jasmine rice.

recipes.name: Pad Thai
steps: Soak noodles till pliable.
Stir-fry tofu + egg; add noodles and tamarind-palm sugar-soy sauce.
Toss with sprouts, top with crushed peanuts and lime.

recipes.name: Kung Pao Chicken
steps: Velvet chicken in cornflour + soy.
Wok-fry chillies and Sichuan pepper; add chicken.
Sauce of soy, vinegar, sugar; toss with peanuts and spring onion.

recipes.name: Veg Hakka Noodles
steps: Boil noodles al dente; toss in oil.
High-flame wok-fry garlic and veg.
Add noodles + sauces; toss on max heat for the 'wok hei' char.

recipes.name: Chicken Teriyaki Bowl
steps: Pan-sear chicken skin-side down till crisp.
Add soy, mirin, sugar; reduce to a glaze.
Slice over rice; sesame and spring onion.

recipes.name: Miso Ramen
steps: Whisk miso into hot stock (don't boil).
Cook noodles separately; add to bowls.
Top with corn, greens, halved soft egg, nori.

recipes.name: Chicken Tacos
steps: Marinate chicken in chipotle, cumin, lime; sear and chop.
Char tortillas on the flame.
Fill with chicken, onion-coriander, salsa, a squeeze of lime.

recipes.name: Bean & Cheese Burrito
steps: Warm beans with cumin; melt in cheese.
Layer rice, beans, salsa on tortilla.
Fold into a burrito; toast seam-side down till golden.

recipes.name: Falafel Hummus Bowl
steps: Blitz soaked chickpeas with herbs, garlic, cumin; fry falafel.
Blend hummus: chickpea, tahini, lemon, garlic.
Bowl it up with salad, pickles, olive oil.

recipes.name: Chicken Shish Tawook
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt, lemon, garlic, paprika 3+ hrs.
Skewer and grill till charred at the edges.
Serve with toum (garlic sauce) and flatbread.

recipes.name: Korean Fried Chicken
steps: Double-fry cornstarch-coated wings till shatteringly crisp.
Reduce gochujang, honey, soy, garlic to a glaze.
Toss wings through; sesame and spring onion.

recipes.name: Bibimbap
steps: Sauté each vegetable separately, seasoned lightly.
Arrange over rice in sections; top with fried egg.
Add gochujang and sesame oil; mix at the table.

recipes.name: Classic Cheeseburger
steps: Smash patty hard on a screaming-hot pan; season.
Melt cheese over; toast buns in the fat.
Build with lettuce, tomato, pickle, sauce.

recipes.name: Mac & Cheese
steps: Cook macaroni; make a roux with butter and flour.
Whisk in milk to a béchamel; melt in cheese.
Fold pasta through; bake with a crumb top if you like.

recipes.name: Chicken Souvlaki
steps: Marinate chicken in olive oil, lemon, oregano, garlic.
Grill on skewers till charred.
Wrap in pita with tzatziki, tomato, onion.

recipes.name: Greek Salad
steps: Chunk cucumber, tomato, onion, pepper.
Top with a slab of feta and olives.
Dress with olive oil, oregano, red wine vinegar.

recipes.name: Grilled Fish & Veg
steps: Pat fish dry; sear skin-side in butter till crisp.
Grill veg alongside with olive oil and thyme.
Finish with lemon and flaky salt.

recipes.name: Pho Bo
steps: Simmer broth with charred aromatics and whole spices 1 hr+.
Blanch noodles; slice raw beef thin.
Ladle boiling broth over — herbs, lime, chilli at the table.

recipes.name: Chettinad Chicken
steps: Dry-roast and grind the Chettinad spice blend.
Cook onion-tomato base; add chicken and masala.
Simmer with roasted coconut till thick and dark.

recipes.name: Dhokla
steps: Whisk besan-curd batter; activate with eno.
Steam in a greased tin 15–18 min till spongy.
Temper mustard, curry leaves, green chilli; pour over. Cut into squares.

recipes.name: Poha
steps: Rinse poha till just soft; drain.
Temper mustard, curry leaves, peanuts, onion, turmeric.
Fold in poha, lemon and coriander. Serve with sev.

recipes.name: Sabudana Vada
steps: Mix soaked sabudana, mashed potato, crushed peanuts, chilli.
Shape into patties.
Deep-fry golden; serve with peanut-curd chutney.

recipes.name: Kolhapuri Mutton
steps: Roast and grind coconut-onion kaanda-lasun masala.
Sear mutton; add fiery masala and water.
Pressure-cook then simmer till oil floats. Serve with bhakri.

recipes.name: Thepla
steps: Knead flour with methi, curd, spices into a soft dough.
Roll thin rounds.
Roast on tawa with oil till speckled. Great with chundo or curd.

recipes.name: Undhiyu
steps: Make green masala of coriander, coconut, chilli.
Stuff and layer winter vegetables with muthia.
Slow-cook till everything is tender and fragrant.

recipes.name: Khaman Dhokla
steps: Whisk besan batter with sugar-citric; activate eno.
Steam till spongy.
Soak in a sweet-tangy tadka; garnish coconut-coriander.

recipes.name: Dal Baati Churma
steps: Bake or fry hard wheat baatis.
Cook a five-lentil dal with ghee tadka.
Crush baati into churma with ghee-jaggery. Drown baati in dal and ghee.

recipes.name: Gatte Ki Sabzi
steps: Steam besan logs (gatte); slice.
Make a spicy curd-based gravy.
Simmer gatte in gravy till they soak it up.

recipes.name: Ker Sangri
steps: Soak and boil ker-sangri.
Temper with chilli, amchur, dry spices in oil.
Cook dry with raisins. A true desert classic.

recipes.name: Laal Maas
steps: Soak fiery Mathania chillies; grind to paste.
Cook mutton in ghee with garlic and chilli paste.
Add curd; slow-cook till deep red. Smoke with charcoal.

recipes.name: Goan Fish Curry
steps: Grind coconut-chilli-tamarind masala.
Simmer masala with kokum and water.
Slide fish in; cook 8 min. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Pork Vindaloo
steps: Marinate pork in vinegar-chilli-garlic paste overnight.
Cook down slowly till pork is tender.
Balance with jaggery. Fierce, sour, unforgettable.

recipes.name: Goan Veg Xacuti
steps: Dry-roast coconut and whole spices; grind dark.
Cook veg in onion base with the masala.
Simmer till thick; finish with tamarind.

recipes.name: Kosha Mangsho
steps: Marinate mutton in curd, ginger-garlic.
Bhuno with onions in mustard oil, low and slow.
Cook dry-ish till dark and glossy. Best with luchi.

recipes.name: Shorshe Ilish
steps: Make a pungent mustard-green chilli paste.
Coat hilsa; steam or gentle simmer in mustard oil.
Serve over steamed rice. Iconic Bengali monsoon dish.

recipes.name: Aloo Posto
steps: Grind poppy seeds to a smooth paste.
Fry potatoes; add posto paste and chilli.
Cook till the paste coats each cube. Comfort food.

recipes.name: Cham Cham
steps: Knead fresh chhena smooth; shape oblongs.
Simmer in light sugar syrup till doubled.
Fill with khoya; garnish coconut. Bengali sweet-shop classic.

recipes.name: Assamese Duck Curry
steps: Sear duck in mustard oil with whole spices.
Add ash gourd and ginger; simmer long.
Cook till duck is tender and gravy thick.

recipes.name: Assamese Khar
steps: Boil papaya and pulses with khar alkali.
Temper lightly in mustard oil.
A cleansing, subtly alkaline Assamese staple. Serve first, with rice.

recipes.name: Andhra Chicken Curry
steps: Roast Guntur chillies and grind hot masala.
Cook onion base; add chicken and masala.
Simmer till fiery and thick.

recipes.name: Gongura Pappu
steps: Cook toor dal soft.
Wilt tangy gongura leaves and mash into the dal.
Finish with a garlic-red chilli tadka. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Kerala Fish Molee
steps: Saute onion, ginger, green chilli, curry leaves.
Add thin coconut milk; poach fish.
Finish with thick coconut milk. Gentle and creamy.

recipes.name: Kerala Avial
steps: Cook mixed veg till just tender.
Add coarse coconut-cumin-chilli paste and curd.
Finish with raw coconut oil and curry leaves.

recipes.name: Malabar Prawn Biryani
steps: Cook a spiced prawn masala.
Par-cook short-grain kaima rice.
Layer with fried onion and mint; dum 20 min.

recipes.name: Awadhi Galouti Kebab
steps: Blend mince smooth with papaya and warm spices.
Rest so the meat tenderises.
Pan-sear soft patties in ghee. Melt-in-mouth Lucknowi kebab.

recipes.name: Sindhi Kadhi
steps: Roast besan; whisk into water with tamarind.
Fry vegetables and add to the tangy curry.
Simmer till thick. Serve with plain rice.

recipes.name: Dilli Butter Chicken Roll
steps: Warm creamy butter-chicken filling.
Lay on a soft rumali roti with onion and chutney.
Roll tight, sear the seam. Delhi street favourite.

recipes.name: Chicken Seekh Roll
steps: Grill spiced chicken seekh on skewers.
Egg-coat and crisp a paratha.
Wrap seekh with onion, chutney, lime.

recipes.name: Aloo Paratha
steps: Make spiced mashed-potato filling.
Stuff and roll parathas carefully.
Roast with ghee/butter till golden. Serve with curd and pickle.

recipes.name: Amritsari Kulcha
steps: Ferment a soft maida dough.
Stuff with spiced aloo-paneer; press coriander on top.
Tandoor/tawa-bake, slather butter. Serve with chole.

recipes.name: Amritsari Fish
steps: Marinate fish in besan-ajwain-chilli batter.
Deep-fry till crisp and golden.
Dust chaat masala; serve with mint chutney.

recipes.name: Rasam & Rice
steps: Simmer tamarind-tomato water with rasam powder.
Add cooked dal; do not boil hard.
Tadka of mustard, cumin, garlic, curry leaves. Serve over rice.

recipes.name: Uttapam
steps: Pour thick batter on tawa; scatter chopped veg on top.
Cook till base is golden and top set.
Serve with sambar and chutney.

recipes.name: Ven Pongal
steps: Cook rice and moong dal to a soft mush.
Temper pepper, cumin, cashew, ginger in ghee.
Fold through. Comforting South Indian breakfast.

recipes.name: Medu Vada
steps: Grind urad dal to a fluffy batter.
Shape rings; deep-fry crisp.
Serve with sambar and coconut chutney.

recipes.name: Chana Masala
steps: Pressure-cook soaked chana soft.
Cook onion-tomato-ginger masala.
Simmer chana in; finish with amchur and coriander.

recipes.name: Malai Kofta
steps: Fry paneer-potato koftas golden.
Make a rich cashew-tomato gravy.
Add koftas just before serving so they stay soft.

recipes.name: Kadai Paneer
steps: Roast and crush a coriander-chilli kadai masala.
Saute onion-capsicum-tomato.
Toss paneer through; keep it semi-dry.

recipes.name: Shahi Paneer
steps: Make a pale, rich nut-onion gravy.
Add saffron, cream and a touch of sugar.
Simmer paneer through. Royal and mild.

recipes.name: Nihari
steps: Slow-cook shanks with nihari spices for hours.
Thicken the stew with wheat-flour slurry.
Garnish ginger, chilli, fried onion. A morning feast.

recipes.name: Hyderabadi Haleem
steps: Cook meat, wheat and lentils to a paste over hours.
Pound smooth; enrich with ghee.
Top with fried onion, cashew, mint, lemon. Ramzan special.

recipes.name: Chicken Chettinad Roast
steps: Marinate chicken in dark Chettinad spice paste.
Sear then roast semi-dry.
Finish with curry leaves and crushed pepper.

recipes.name: Sev Tameta Nu Shaak
steps: Cook tomatoes into a sweet-spicy gravy.
Balance with jaggery and chilli.
Top with sev at the table so it stays crunchy.

recipes.name: Modak
steps: Cook coconut-jaggery filling.
Shape rice-flour dough shells; fill and pleat.
Steam till glossy. Ganpati's favourite.

recipes.name: Bisi Bele Bath
steps: Cook rice, dal and veg together soft.
Stir in the spice powder and tamarind.
Ghee tadka with cashews. Karnataka one-pot classic.

recipes.name: Mysore Masala Dosa
steps: Spread dosa; smear fiery red garlic chutney inside.
Add potato masala; fold.
Crisp with ghee. Serve with sambar and chutney.

recipes.name: Mutton Keema Pav
steps: Cook onion-tomato masala; brown the keema.
Simmer till spicy and moist.
Butter-toast pav; serve with lemon and onion.

recipes.name: Bombay Sandwich
steps: Butter bread; spread green chutney.
Layer boiled potato, cucumber, tomato, onion, beetroot.
Grill or serve cold. Dust chaat masala.

recipes.name: Kathiyawadi Chicken
steps: Cook a fiery garlic-onion rustic base.
Add chicken and Kathiyawadi masala.
Simmer spicy; finish with coriander. Serve with bajra rotla.

recipes.name: Kashmiri Yakhni
steps: Cook mutton with whole spices till tender.
Whisk in curd off the heat; simmer gently.
Season with fennel and dry ginger. Mild, aromatic Kashmiri gravy.

recipes.name: Nadru Yakhni
steps: Clean and slice lotus stem; par-boil.
Cook in a whisked-curd gravy with Kashmiri spices.
Simmer gently till nadru is tender.

recipes.name: Shufta
steps: Fry paneer and dried fruits lightly.
Make a spiced saffron sugar syrup.
Toss everything through. A Kashmiri festive dessert.

recipes.name: Kashmiri Rajma
steps: Soak and pressure-cook the small red rajma.
Cook in onion-tomato with Kashmiri chilli and fennel.
Simmer thick. Serve with rice.

recipes.name: Chilli Chicken
steps: Batter-fry chicken crisp.
Toss with capsicum, onion, garlic, green chilli.
Coat in a soy-chilli sauce. Dry or gravy - your call.

recipes.name: Veg Manchurian
steps: Make veg balls; deep-fry.
Toss in a garlicky soy-chilli sauce.
Thicken with slurry for gravy or keep dry.

recipes.name: Gobi Manchurian
steps: Batter-fry cauliflower florets crisp.
Toss in a sticky garlic-soy-chilli sauce.
Finish with spring onion.

recipes.name: Schezwan Fried Rice
steps: Stir-fry veg on high heat.
Add rice and schezwan sauce; toss hard.
Finish with spring onion. Fiery and fast.

recipes.name: Penne Arrabbiata
steps: Cook penne al dente.
Sizzle garlic and chilli in olive oil; add tomato.
Toss pasta through; finish with basil.

recipes.name: Mushroom Risotto
steps: Toast rice; deglaze with wine.
Ladle stock in slowly, stirring, till creamy.
Fold mushrooms, butter and parmesan.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Carbonara
steps: Crisp pancetta.
Toss hot pasta off-heat with yolk-cheese mix.
Emulsify with pasta water. Never scramble the egg.

recipes.name: Chicken Parmigiana
steps: Bread and fry chicken cutlets.
Top with marinara and mozzarella.
Bake till bubbling. Serve with pasta.

recipes.name: Bruschetta
steps: Toast and rub bread with garlic.
Top with tomato-basil-olive oil.
Finish with salt and balsamic.

recipes.name: Margherita Calzone
steps: Fill dough with cheese, sauce and basil.
Fold into a half-moon; seal.
Bake till golden. Serve with extra marinara.

recipes.name: Thai Red Curry
steps: Fry red curry paste in coconut cream.
Add coconut milk, veg and tofu; simmer.
Finish with basil and lime.

recipes.name: Tom Yum Goong
steps: Simmer aromatics in stock.
Add prawns, mushrooms, chilli.
Balance lime, fish sauce, chilli. Hot and sour.

recipes.name: Mango Sticky Rice
steps: Steam sticky rice.
Soak in sweet-salty coconut milk.
Serve with ripe mango slices.

recipes.name: Thai Basil Chicken
steps: Pound garlic and chilli.
Stir-fry mince hard and fast.
Toss with sauces and holy basil. Serve over rice with a fried egg.

recipes.name: Sweet & Sour Pork
steps: Batter and fry pork crisp.
Make a glossy sweet-sour sauce.
Toss pork, pineapple and peppers through.

recipes.name: Mapo Tofu
steps: Fry chilli-bean paste and aromatics.
Add stock and cubed tofu; simmer gently.
Thicken; finish with numbing Sichuan pepper.

recipes.name: Dim Sum Chicken Dumplings
steps: Mix seasoned chicken filling.
Pleat into dumplings.
Steam 8-10 min; serve with soy-chilli dip.

recipes.name: Chicken Katsu Curry
steps: Bread and fry chicken katsu.
Make Japanese curry sauce with onion and carrot.
Slice katsu over rice; ladle curry.

recipes.name: Salmon Teriyaki
steps: Sear salmon skin-side down.
Reduce soy-mirin-sugar to a glaze.
Coat fish; scatter sesame and spring onion.

recipes.name: Vegetable Sushi Rolls
steps: Season rice with vinegar-sugar-salt.
Roll with veg in nori using a mat.
Slice; serve with soy, wasabi, ginger.

recipes.name: Miso Soup
steps: Heat dashi; do not boil.
Whisk in miso off the heat.
Add tofu, wakame, spring onion.

recipes.name: Bibimbap Beef
steps: Saute seasoned beef and separate veg.
Arrange over rice in a bowl.
Top with gochujang and a fried egg; mix at the table.

recipes.name: Kimchi Fried Rice
steps: Fry kimchi with a little gochujang.
Toss in rice on high heat.
Top with a fried egg and sesame.

recipes.name: Korean Bulgogi
steps: Marinate thin beef in sweet soy-pear.
Sear hard on a hot grill.
Serve with rice, lettuce wraps and ssamjang.

recipes.name: Chicken Enchiladas
steps: Fill tortillas with spiced chicken; roll.
Cover with red enchilada sauce and cheese.
Bake till bubbling.

recipes.name: Veg Quesadilla
steps: Saute peppers, corn and beans.
Fill tortilla with veg and cheese; fold.
Griddle till crisp; serve with salsa.

recipes.name: Guacamole & Nachos
steps: Mash avocado with lime and salt.
Fold in onion, tomato, coriander, chilli.
Serve with crunchy tortilla chips.

recipes.name: Beef Burrito Bowl
steps: Cook spiced beef and beans.
Build a bowl over rice with corn and salsa.
Top with sour cream, cheese and guac.

recipes.name: Shakshuka
steps: Cook a spiced tomato-pepper sauce.
Make wells; crack in eggs.
Cover and poach till just set. Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Hummus & Pita
steps: Blend chickpeas with tahini, lemon, garlic, olive oil till silky.
Swirl and top with paprika and oil.
Serve with warm pita.

recipes.name: Tabbouleh
steps: Soak fine bulgur.
Toss with heaps of parsley, mint, tomato.
Dress with lemon and olive oil. Herb-forward.

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma Plate
steps: Marinate chicken in shawarma spice and yogurt.
Roast and slice thin.
Serve with garlic toum, pickles, rice or pita.

recipes.name: Falafel Wrap
steps: Blend soaked chickpeas with herbs and spices.
Shape and fry falafel crisp.
Wrap with tahini, salad and pickles.

recipes.name: Chicken Adana Kebab
steps: Mix mince with pepper paste and spices.
Press onto flat skewers.
Grill over coals; serve with sumac onions and lavash.

recipes.name: Turkish Menemen

Add tomato; cook down.
Fold in eggs softly. Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Baklava
steps: Layer buttered filo with crushed nuts.
Bake till golden and crisp.
Drench in fragrant syrup. Rest before cutting.

recipes.name: Spanakopita
steps: Cook spinach with onion; mix with feta.
Layer buttered filo with the filling.
Bake till crisp and golden.

recipes.name: Moussaka
steps: Fry aubergine slices.
Cook a spiced lamb-tomato ragu.
Layer aubergine, ragu, bechamel; bake till set.

recipes.name: Seafood Paella
steps: Build a sofrito; toast rice.
Add saffron stock; do not stir once seafood is in.
Cook till socarrat forms. Finish with lemon.

recipes.name: Patatas Bravas
steps: Fry potato cubes crisp.
Make a spicy brava tomato sauce.
Drizzle brava and garlic aioli. Tapas staple.

recipes.name: Gazpacho
steps: Blend raw tomato, cucumber, pepper, garlic.
Emulsify with olive oil and vinegar.
Chill deeply; serve cold. Summer in a glass.

recipes.name: Coq au Vin
steps: Brown chicken and bacon.
Braise slowly in red wine with aromatics.
Reduce sauce till glossy. Serve with mash.

recipes.name: Ratatouille
steps: Cook a tomato-pepper base.
Layer thin-sliced vegetables.
Bake low with herbs and olive oil till silky.

recipes.name: Quiche Lorraine
steps: Blind-bake the pastry shell.
Whisk egg-cream custard with cheese.
Add fillings; bake till just set.

recipes.name: Crepes with Nutella
steps: Whisk a thin crepe batter; rest.
Cook lacy thin crepes.
Fill with chocolate spread and fruit; fold.

recipes.name: BBQ Pulled Pork
steps: Rub and slow-roast pork for hours.
Shred; toss in BBQ sauce.
Pile into buns with slaw.

recipes.name: Buttermilk Pancakes
steps: Whisk a light lumpy batter.
Cook fluffy pancakes on a griddle.
Stack with butter and maple syrup.

recipes.name: Buffalo Wings
steps: Fry or bake wings crisp.
Toss in melted butter-hot sauce.
Serve with blue cheese dip and celery.

recipes.name: BBQ Ribs
steps: Rub ribs; slow-cook low and slow.
Baste with BBQ sauce repeatedly.
Finish on high heat for sticky char.

recipes.name: Fish & Chips
steps: Make a light beer batter.
Fry battered fish and thick chips.
Serve with mushy peas and malt vinegar.

recipes.name: Shepherd's Pie
steps: Cook a savoury lamb-veg filling.
Top with creamy mashed potato.
Bake till the top is golden and crisp.

recipes.name: Full English Veg Breakfast

Warm baked beans; crisp hash browns.
Plate it all up with buttered toast.

recipes.name: Misir Wot & Injera
steps: Slow-cook onions to a soft base.
Add berbere and lentils; simmer spicy.
Scoop with sour injera. No cutlery needed.

recipes.name: Doro Wat
steps: Cook mountains of onion down slowly.
Add berbere and spiced butter; then chicken.
Simmer long; add boiled eggs. Ethiopian national dish.

recipes.name: Nasi Goreng
steps: Fry sambal and aromatics.
Toss rice with protein and kecap manis.
Top with a fried egg, prawn crackers, cucumber.

recipes.name: Beef Rendang
steps: Blend a rich rempah spice paste.
Simmer beef in coconut milk for hours.
Cook till dry, dark and intensely flavoured.

recipes.name: Gado Gado
steps: Blanch mixed vegetables.
Make a sweet-spicy peanut sauce.
Arrange veg, egg, tofu; drown in peanut sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken Laksa
steps: Fry laksa paste; add coconut milk and stock.
Simmer chicken till done.
Ladle over noodles with tofu puffs, sprouts, lime.

recipes.name: Nasi Lemak
steps: Cook fragrant coconut-pandan rice.
Make a sweet-spicy sambal.
Plate with sambal, anchovies, peanuts, egg, cucumber.

recipes.name: Chicken Adobo
steps: Braise chicken in soy, vinegar, garlic, bay.
Reduce the sauce till glossy.
Serve over rice. The Filipino national dish.

recipes.name: Pork Sinigang
steps: Simmer pork till tender.
Sour the broth heavily with tamarind.
Add vegetables; finish with fish sauce. Comforting and sour.

recipes.name: Jamaican Jerk Chicken
steps: Blend a fiery jerk marinade.
Marinate chicken overnight.
Grill over smoky coals till charred. Serve with rice and peas.

recipes.name: Rice & Peas
steps: Cook beans with coconut milk and thyme.
Add rice and a whole chilli.
Steam till fluffy. The Caribbean side dish.

recipes.name: Pork Schnitzel
steps: Pound cutlets thin.
Bread and shallow-fry golden.
Serve with lemon and potato salad.

recipes.name: Currywurst

Make a curry-spiced ketchup sauce.
Pour over; dust curry powder. Serve with fries. Berlin street classic.

recipes.name: Fresh Spring Rolls
steps: Soak rice paper briefly.
Roll with vermicelli, herbs and filling.
Serve with peanut-hoisin dipping sauce.

recipes.name: Banh Mi
steps: Crisp the baguette.
Layer pate, protein, pickles, herbs.
Add chilli and a squeeze of lime. Vietnamese sandwich.

recipes.name: Chicken Ramen
steps: Simmer a rich chicken broth.
Season with soy-miso tare.
Assemble noodles, sliced chicken, egg, nori.

recipes.name: Vegetable Hakka Chow
steps: Boil noodles al dente.
Stir-fry julienned veg on high heat.
Toss noodles with sauces; finish spring onion.

recipes.name: Chilaquiles
steps: Simmer a bright salsa.
Fold in tortilla chips just till softened.
Top with egg, cheese, cream, onion. Mexican breakfast.

recipes.name: Lamb Kofta Tagine
steps: Roll spiced lamb koftas.
Simmer in a spiced tomato tagine sauce.
Crack eggs on top to poach. Serve with bread.

recipes.name: Caprese Salad
steps: Slice tomato and mozzarella.
Alternate with basil leaves.
Drizzle olive oil, balsamic, salt. Simple perfection.

recipes.name: Creamy Mushroom Soup

Simmer with stock; blend part-smooth.
Finish with cream and thyme.

Layer sheets, ragu, bechamel, cheese.
Bake till golden and bubbling.

Temper mustard, curry leaves, veg, cashew.
Add water; steam till fluffy. Finish with lemon.

Temper mustard, curry leaves, onion, cashew.
Add water; stir rava in till fluffy.

recipes.name: Kheer

Sweeten; add cardamom and nuts.
Serve warm or chilled. Festive comfort.

Boil in light sugar syrup till spongy and doubled.
Cool in the syrup. Melt-in-mouth Bengali sweet.

recipes.name: Fruit Chaat

Toss with chaat masala, lemon, black salt.
Garnish mint. Refreshing and quick.

recipes.name: Egg Roll

Add onion, chilli, chutney.
Roll tight. Kolkata street staple.

Simmer with tomato purée, butter and spices for 45 min.
Finish with cream and a smoky charcoal dhungar.

recipes.name: Kadhai Paneer

Sauté onion, tomato, capsicum.
Add paneer and masala; toss high.

recipes.name: Sarson Ka Saag

Thicken with makki flour.
Temper ghee, garlic. Serve with makki roti.

Cook in cashew-onion gravy.
Finish with saffron and cream.

recipes.name: Galouti Kebab

Rest; shape soft patties.
Shallow fry on low. Melt-in-mouth.

Thicken gravy with flour slurry.
Garnish ginger, fried onion, lemon.

recipes.name: Seekh Kebab
steps: Mix mince with onion and spices.
Mould onto skewers.
Grill over charcoal. Mint chutney.

Layer with 70% cooked rice, mint, saffron.
Seal and dum-cook 45 min.

Layer with par-boiled rice and mint.
Dum 25 min. Serve with raita.

Layer rice and eggs with mint.
Dum 20 min.

Add sautéed sour gongura leaves.
Simmer fiery red-chilli masala.

recipes.name: Appam with Stew

Simmer veg stew in coconut milk.
Serve together.

recipes.name: Chingri Malai Curry

Cook onion paste; add coconut milk.
Simmer prawns till rich.

recipes.name: Shukto
steps: Fry bitter gourd and veg.
Simmer in milk with mustard paste.
Temper panch phoron.

recipes.name: Mishti Doi

Cool and mix curd starter.
Set in earthen pot overnight.

recipes.name: Khaman

Pour sweet-tangy tempering over.
Garnish coriander and coconut.

recipes.name: Gujarati Kadhi
steps: Whisk curd and besan smooth.
Simmer with jaggery and ginger.
Temper cloves, cinnamon.

recipes.name: Misal Pav
steps: Cook sprout usal with fiery kat gravy.
Top with farsan, onion, coriander.
Serve with buttered pav.

recipes.name: Vada Pav

Smear pav with garlic and green chutney.
Sandwich the vada.

recipes.name: Puran Poli
steps: Cook chana dal with jaggery to a sweet puran.
Stuff into soft dough; roll gently.
Roast with ghee.

recipes.name: Kolhapuri Chicken
steps: Roast and grind coconut-spice masala.
Cook chicken in the fiery gravy.
Finish with tambda rassa heat.

recipes.name: Prawn Balchao

Cook prawns in the pickle-like gravy.
Store-friendly and intense.

recipes.name: Goan Sausage Pulao
steps: Fry spicy chouriço sausages.
Cook rice with the rendered masala.
A punchy one-pot.

recipes.name: Kashmiri Rogan Josh

Add ratanjot, fennel, dry ginger, curd.
Slow-simmer to a red glossy gravy.

recipes.name: Yakhni Pulao
steps: Make aromatic mutton yakhni stock.
Cook rice in the stock with curd.
Fragrant and gentle.

recipes.name: Kashmiri Dum Aloo
steps: Fry pricked baby potatoes.
Simmer in fennel-ginger curd gravy.
Deep red, no onion-garlic.

recipes.name: Kashmiri Haak Saag
steps: Boil haak greens with mustard oil.
Add whole chilli and hing.
Serve brothy with rice.

recipes.name: Litti Chokha

Roast brinjal-tomato-potato for chokha.
Dip litti in ghee.

recipes.name: Sattu Paratha
steps: Season sattu with spices and mustard oil.
Stuff into dough; roll and roast.
High-protein and rustic.

recipes.name: Masor Tenga

Make a light sour tomato-lemon broth.
Simmer fish briefly. Refreshing.

recipes.name: Aloo Pitika

Mix raw mustard oil, onion, chilli, coriander.
Simple Assamese comfort.

recipes.name: Sindhi Sai Bhaji

Mash coarse with veg.
A wholesome one-pot.

recipes.name: Chilli Paneer

Stir-fry peppers, onion, chilli, soy.
Toss paneer through the sauce.

recipes.name: Chicken Manchurian
steps: Fry battered chicken.
Simmer in spicy soy-garlic gravy.
Serve with fried rice.

recipes.name: Veg Manchow Soup

Add stock, soy, thicken with corn flour.
Top with crunchy fried noodles.

recipes.name: Lasagna Bolognese

Layer pasta, ragù and bechamel.
Bake till golden.

Layer with mascarpone cream.
Dust cocoa; chill overnight.

recipes.name: Minestrone Soup

Add veg, beans, tomato, stock.

recipes.name: Fettuccine Alfredo

Melt butter, cream and parmesan.
Toss to a glossy emulsion.

recipes.name: Croissant

Shape and proof crescents.
Bake till flaky and golden.

recipes.name: French Onion Soup

Deglaze; add stock and simmer.
Top with bread and gruyère; grill.

recipes.name: Crème Brûlée

Chill till set.
Torch a sugar crust on top.

Braise low with veg and herbs 2 hrs.
Reduce to a deep, silky stew.

recipes.name: Croque Monsieur

Top with bechamel and cheese.
Grill till bubbling.

recipes.name: Paella Valenciana

Form the crisp socarrat base.

recipes.name: Spanish Tortilla

Mix with beaten eggs.
Set into a thick omelette; flip.

recipes.name: Churros con Chocolate

Roll in cinnamon sugar.
Serve with thick hot chocolate.

recipes.name: Gambas al Ajillo
steps: Sizzle garlic and chilli in olive oil.
Add prawns; cook just till pink.
Serve with crusty bread.

recipes.name: Falafel Plate
steps: Blend soaked chickpeas with herbs.
Shape and deep-fry balls.
Serve with tahini, pita, salad.

recipes.name: Gyro Wrap

Warm pita.
Wrap with tzatziki, tomato, onion, fries.

recipes.name: Chicken Shawarma
steps: Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices.
Grill and slice thin.
Wrap in pita with garlic sauce and pickles.

recipes.name: Lamb Kofta Kebab
steps: Mix mince with grated onion and spices.
Mould onto skewers.
Grill over coals; serve with flatbread.

recipes.name: Hummus
steps: Blend chickpeas with tahini, lemon, garlic.
Whip till silky.
Drizzle olive oil and paprika.

recipes.name: Turkish Lahmacun
steps: Spread thin spiced mince on dough.
Bake very hot till crisp.
Roll with lemon and parsley.

recipes.name: Manti Dumplings

Boil till tender.
Top with garlic yogurt and paprika butter.

recipes.name: Moroccan Lamb Tagine
steps: Brown lamb with spices.
Slow-cook with apricots and almonds.
Serve with couscous.

recipes.name: Couscous Royale
steps: Steam couscous fluffy.
Cook spiced chicken-vegetable broth.
Serve with harissa.

recipes.name: Dim Sum Dumplings

Pleat into dumplings.
Steam 8 min; soy-chilli dip.

recipes.name: Chow Mein
steps: Boil noodles.
Stir-fry veg on high heat.
Toss with soy and sesame oil.

recipes.name: Wonton Soup

Poach in clear stock.
Garnish spring onion.

recipes.name: Dan Dan Noodles
steps: Fry preserved-veg pork mince.
Build chilli-oil sesame sauce.
Top noodles; mix in numbing heat.

recipes.name: Vegetable Tempura
steps: Make ice-cold lumpy batter.
Dip veg; fry light and crisp.
Serve with tentsuyu dip.

recipes.name: Onigiri
steps: Season warm rice.
Shape triangles around filling.
Wrap with nori.

recipes.name: Chicken Yakitori
steps: Skewer chicken and spring onion.
Grill, basting with tare.
Caramelise the glaze.

recipes.name: Tonkatsu
steps: Bread pork in panko.
Deep-fry golden.
Serve with shredded cabbage and sauce.

recipes.name: Kimchi Jjigae
steps: Fry aged kimchi and pork.
Add stock and gochugaru.
Simmer with tofu.

recipes.name: Japchae
steps: Boil glass noodles.
Stir-fry veg separately.
Toss in soy-sesame sauce.

recipes.name: Tteokbokki
steps: Simmer rice cakes in gochujang sauce.
Add fish cake.
Cook till glossy and chewy.

recipes.name: Bulgogi
steps: Marinate thin beef in soy-pear-sesame.
Sear on high heat.
Serve with rice and lettuce wraps.

recipes.name: Tom Yum Soup
steps: Simmer aromatics in stock.
Add prawns and mushrooms.
Balance sour-spicy with lime and chilli.

recipes.name: Massaman Curry
steps: Fry massaman paste.
Braise beef and potato in coconut milk.
Add peanuts and tamarind.

recipes.name: Thai Red Curry Veg

Add coconut milk and veg.
Simmer; finish with basil.

recipes.name: Papaya Salad (Som Tum)
steps: Pound chilli, garlic, palm sugar.
Add shredded papaya, lime, fish sauce.
Toss with peanuts and tomato.

recipes.name: Bun Cha
steps: Grill pork patties.
Make sweet-sour nuoc cham broth.
Serve with noodles and fresh herbs.

recipes.name: Chicken Satay
steps: Marinate and skewer chicken.
Grill over charcoal.
Serve with peanut sauce.

recipes.name: Char Kway Teow
steps: Fry noodles on searing wok heat.
Add prawns, egg, sprouts.
Char for smoky wok hei.

recipes.name: Laksa
steps: Fry laksa paste; add coconut milk.
Simmer to a rich curry broth.
Assemble with noodles, prawns, tofu puffs.

recipes.name: Sinigang
steps: Boil pork till tender.
Sour the broth with tamarind.
Add vegetables. Comforting sour soup.

recipes.name: Pork Sisig
steps: Boil, grill and chop pork crisp.
Toss with onion, chilli, calamansi.
Sizzle on a hot plate with egg.

recipes.name: Hainanese Chicken Rice

Cook rice in the chicken fat and stock.
Serve with ginger and chilli sauce.

recipes.name: Singapore Chilli Crab
steps: Fry crab in aromatics.
Simmer in sweet-spicy tomato-chilli sauce.
Ribbon in egg. Serve with mantou.

recipes.name: Beef Burrito
steps: Cook seasoned beef, rice, beans.
Pile into tortilla with cheese.
Roll tight and griddle.

recipes.name: Enchiladas

Cover with red chilli sauce and cheese.
Bake till bubbling.

recipes.name: Quesadilla
steps: Fill tortilla with cheese and veg.
Griddle till melty and crisp.
Cut into wedges; salsa on the side.

recipes.name: Pancakes with Maple

Griddle golden pancakes.
Stack with butter and maple.

recipes.name: Caesar Salad
steps: Toss crisp romaine with dressing.
Add croutons and parmesan.
Top with grilled chicken if desired.

recipes.name: Full English Breakfast
steps: Fry eggs, sausage, bacon.
Grill tomato and mushroom.
Serve with beans and toast.

recipes.name: Sticky Toffee Pudding
steps: Bake moist date sponge.
Make sticky toffee sauce.
Drench warm; serve with cream.

recipes.name: Bratwurst & Sauerkraut
steps: Grill bratwurst.
Warm sauerkraut with caraway.
Serve with mustard and roll.

recipes.name: Käsespätzle
steps: Make egg spätzle dough; boil.
Layer with cheese.
Top with crispy fried onions.

recipes.name: Black Forest Cake
steps: Layer chocolate sponge with cherries.
Frost with whipped cream.
Top with chocolate shavings.

recipes.name: Misir Wot
steps: Cook onions dry, then add berbere.
Simmer red lentils till soft.
Serve with injera.

recipes.name: Injera
steps: Ferment teff batter 2-3 days.
Pour thin on hot griddle.
Cover till spongy with eyes.

recipes.name: Ethiopian Tibs
steps: Sear beef cubes hot.
Add onion, chilli, berbere.
Sauté quick with rosemary. Serve with injera.

recipes.name: Jerk Chicken
steps: Blend fiery jerk marinade.
Marinate chicken overnight.
Grill over pimento wood for smoke.

recipes.name: Trini Doubles
steps: Fry turmeric bara flatbreads.
Cook curried channa.
Sandwich channa in two baras with chutneys.

recipes.name: Lomo Saltado
steps: Stir-fry beef strips on high heat.
Add onion, tomato, aji, soy.
Serve with fries and rice.

recipes.name: Ceviche
steps: Cure diced fish in lime juice.
Add onion, chilli, coriander.
Serve with sweet potato and corn.

recipes.name: Feijoada
steps: Slow-cook black beans with pork and sausage.
Simmer till thick and dark.
Serve with rice, orange, farofa.

recipes.name: Pao de Queijo
steps: Scald milk-oil into tapioca flour.
Mix cheese and eggs.
Bake into chewy cheese puffs.

recipes.name: Swedish Meatballs

Make creamy gravy.
Serve with mash and lingonberry.

recipes.name: Gravlax
steps: Cure salmon in salt, sugar, dill 2 days.
Slice thin.
Serve with mustard-dill sauce and bread.

recipes.name: Sri Lankan Chicken Curry
steps: Toast dark Sri Lankan curry powder.
Cook chicken in coconut milk.
Add pandan and curry leaves.

recipes.name: Egg Hoppers
steps: Swirl batter in a bowl-shaped pan.
Crack egg into the centre.
Cover; serve with lunu miris.

recipes.name: Chicken Momos
steps: Make thin dough wrappers.
Fill with spiced mince.
Steam 12 min; fiery chutney.

recipes.name: Thukpa
steps: Simmer spiced broth with chicken.
Add noodles and veg.
A warming Himalayan noodle soup.

recipes.name: Nepali Dal Bhat
steps: Cook fluffy rice and tempered dal.
Prepare seasonal tarkari.
Serve as a wholesome platter.

recipes.name: Burmese Khao Suey
steps: Cook chicken in coconut-gram flour gravy.
Boil noodles.
Serve with crunchy garnishes and lime.

recipes.name: Peri Peri Chicken
steps: Butterfly and marinate chicken in peri peri.
Grill, basting with sauce.
Serve with extra sauce and lemon.

recipes.name: Pastel de Nata
steps: Line tins with puff pastry.
Fill with custard.
Bake hot till caramelised on top.

recipes.name: Dal Tadka
steps: Pressure-cook dal soft.
Make a ghee-cumin-garlic tadka.
Pour sizzling over the dal.

recipes.name: Dal Fry
steps: Cook dal; sauté onion-tomato masala.
Combine and simmer.
Finish with butter and coriander.

recipes.name: Rajma Galouti
steps: Mash spiced rajma into a smooth mix.
Shape soft patties.
Shallow fry; smoke with charcoal.

recipes.name: Hara Bhara Kabab
steps: Blanch and mash spinach, peas, potato.
Season and shape patties.
Shallow fry golden.

recipes.name: Jalebi
steps: Ferment maida batter overnight.
Pipe spirals into hot oil; fry crisp.
Dunk in warm saffron syrup.

recipes.name: Masala Chai
steps: Boil water with ginger and spices.
Add tea and milk; simmer.
Strain and serve hot.

recipes.name: Filter Coffee

Boil milk; mix with decoction.
Froth between tumbler and dabara.

recipes.name: Mango Lassi
steps: Blend mango, curd and sugar.
Chill well.
Serve with a cardamom dusting.

recipes.name: Aloo Tikki Chaat
steps: Shallow-fry spiced potato tikkis.
Top with chana, curd, chutneys.
Finish with sev and chaat masala.

recipes.name: Bhel Puri
steps: Toss puffed rice with chutneys.
Add onion, tomato, sev.
Serve immediately for crunch.

recipes.name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
steps: Boil spaghetti.
Slow-sizzle garlic and chilli in olive oil.
Toss with pasta water and parsley.

recipes.name: Pesto Pasta
steps: Blend basil, pine nuts, garlic, parmesan, oil.
Boil pasta.
Toss with pesto and pasta water.

recipes.name: Gnocchi Sorrentina
steps: Boil gnocchi till they float.
Toss in tomato sauce.
Bake with mozzarella till bubbling.

recipes.name: Osso Buco
steps: Brown shanks; braise with wine and stock 2 hrs.
Reduce to tender richness.

recipes.name: Egg Drop Soup
steps: Thicken seasoned stock.
Stream in beaten egg.
Garnish with spring onion.

recipes.name: Chow Mein (Chicken)
steps: Stir-fry chicken and veg.
Add noodles and soy.
Toss on high heat.

recipes.name: Singapore Noodles
steps: Stir-fry prawns, egg and veg.
Toss thin vermicelli with curry powder.
A yellow curried noodle.

recipes.name: Char Siu Bao (Steamed)
steps: Fill fluffy bao dough with sweet char siu.
Pleat and proof.
Steam till pillowy.

recipes.name: Adai Dosa
steps: Soak the three dals and rice together for 3 hours with the dry red chillies.
Grind coarse — adai batter should stay grainy, never smooth like dosa batter, and needs no fermentation.
Stir in chopped onion, curry leaves, asafoetida and salt; rest 15 minutes.
Spread thick on a hot tawa, make a hole in the centre, drizzle oil around and cook till both sides are deep brown and crisp.
Serve hot with avial or a spoon of jaggery and butter.

recipes.name: Kuzhi Paniyaram
steps: Temper mustard seeds, chopped onion, green chilli and curry leaves in a little sesame oil and fold into slightly sour day-old batter.
Heat a paniyaram pan and put a few drops of sesame oil into each mould.
Fill each mould three-quarters full and cook covered on medium heat until the bases are golden.
Turn each ball with a skewer and cook the other side till evenly browned; serve with coconut chutney.

recipes.name: Kanchipuram Idli
steps: Grind soaked rice and urad dal coarse and ferment overnight — this idli is deliberately grainy, not silky.
Beat in crushed pepper, cumin, dry ginger, asafoetida and salt, then fold through ghee-fried cashews and curry leaves.
Line a deep tray or small tumblers with cloth or cashew leaves and pour the batter about two inches deep.
Steam 25–30 minutes until a skewer comes out clean, cool slightly and cut into thick wedges to serve with idli podi.

recipes.name: Upma Kozhukattai
steps: Temper mustard, urad dal, slit green chillies and curry leaves in oil, then pour in 2 cups water with salt and bring to a boil.
Rain in the rice rava while stirring so no lumps form, cook 2 minutes until it pulls away from the pan, then fold in grated coconut.
Cool until it can be handled and roll the dough into small oval dumplings between your palms.
Steam the dumplings 10–12 minutes until glossy and firm; eat warm with coconut chutney.

recipes.name: Lemon Sevai
steps: Steam the rice sevai and fluff it with a fork so the strands stay separate; cool to room temperature.
Temper mustard, chana dal, peanuts, slit chillies and curry leaves in oil until the dal turns golden.
Kill the heat, add turmeric and lemon juice to the tempering so the acid does not cook off.
Fold the tempering through the sevai with salt using a light hand, and serve at once.

recipes.name: Kambu Koozh
steps: Whisk the pearl millet flour into cold water to a lump-free slurry, then cook it on low heat, stirring, until thick and glossy.
Stir in the leftover cooked rice, take off the heat and let it cool completely — hot koozh will split the buttermilk.
Loosen with soured buttermilk and salt to a drinkable porridge.
Serve in a tumbler with raw shallots and a green chilli on the side to bite into.

recipes.name: Thatte Idli
steps: Grind urad dal with fenugreek to a fluffy batter, grind the rice separately with soaked poha, and combine with salt.
Ferment 8 hours until risen and airy — the poha is what gives thatte idli its soft, spongy crumb.
Grease wide flat plates and pour a thin layer so each idli spreads to the size of a saucer.
Steam 10–12 minutes, slide out and serve immediately with a pat of butter, coconut chutney and sambar.

recipes.name: Mangalore Buns
steps: Mash the overripe bananas with sugar, curd, cumin and a pinch of baking soda until slushy.
Work in the flour to a soft sticky dough — no water at all — and leave it covered for 6–8 hours to sour and rise.
Knead again with a little oil and roll into small thick discs, slightly fatter than a puri.
Slide into hot oil and press gently with the ladle so they puff; fry till pale gold and serve with coconut chutney.

recipes.name: Goli Baje
steps: Whisk sour curd with sugar, salt and baking soda, then beat in the flour to a thick dropping batter.
Rest the batter at least 2 hours — the sourness of the curd is what makes goli baje fluffy inside.
Stir in chopped ginger, green chilli, curry leaves and coconut slivers.
Drop rough spoonfuls into medium-hot oil and fry slowly till deep golden so the centres cook through; serve with coconut chutney.

recipes.name: Khara Bath
steps: Dry roast the rava till it smells nutty and set aside — this is what keeps khara bath from turning pasty.
Fry cashews in ghee, then temper mustard and curry leaves, add onion, green chilli and tomato and cook down.
Stir in peas and a generous spoon of vangi bath powder, then pour in three cups of hot water with salt.
Rain in the roasted rava while whisking, cover and cook 4–5 minutes on low, finish with ghee and coriander.

recipes.name: Ragi Malt
steps: Mix ragi flour into cold water to a smooth slurry with no lumps.
Cook on low heat, stirring constantly, for 6–8 minutes until it thickens and loses its raw smell.
Melt jaggery separately in a splash of water, strain, and stir it in off the heat.
Add warm milk and crushed cardamom, whisk till drinkable and serve warm in a tumbler.

recipes.name: Vattayappam
steps: Grind soaked raw rice with cooked rice, grated coconut and a little water to a thick, smooth batter.
Whisk in sugar, a pinch of cumin and yeast bloomed in warm water, and leave to rise 4–6 hours till frothy.
Pour into a greased steel plate no more than an inch deep and scatter over raisins and cashew.
Steam 20–25 minutes until set and springy; cool before cutting into diamonds.

recipes.name: Pazham Pori
steps: Slice the ripe nendran bananas lengthways into thick fingers.
Whisk maida, rice flour, sugar, a pinch of turmeric and salt with water to a batter that coats the back of a spoon.
Dip each banana slice so it is fully cloaked and slide into hot coconut oil.
Fry till the batter is crisp and deep gold, drain on paper and eat hot with evening chai.

recipes.name: Punugulu
steps: Use dosa batter that has gone properly sour — a fresh batter gives flat, oily punugulu.
Beat in rice flour to tighten it, then fold through chopped onion, green chilli, ginger, cumin and salt.
Drop small rounds off a spoon into medium-hot oil, a few at a time so the temperature holds.
Fry until dark golden and crackling, drain, and serve with allam chutney or coconut chutney.

recipes.name: Amboli
steps: Soak rice, urad dal and fenugreek for 5 hours, then grind with coconut and soaked poha to a batter slightly thinner than dosa.
Leave to ferment overnight until it smells pleasantly sour and has risen.
Pour a ladleful onto a hot tawa without spreading it — amboli should stay thick and full of holes on top.
Cover and cook on one side only until the surface is set and dry, then lift off and serve with coconut milk sweetened with jaggery or with a Malvani curry.

recipes.name: Alu Vadi
steps: Wash the colocasia leaves, cut out the thick central vein and flatten them with a rolling pin.
Beat besan with tamarind, jaggery, chilli powder, turmeric and salt to a thick spreadable paste — the tamarind is essential or the leaves will itch the throat.
Stack the leaves shiny side down, spreading paste between each, fold the sides in and roll tight.
Steam the rolls 20 minutes, cool completely, then slice into pinwheels.
Shallow fry the slices in oil tempered with mustard and sesame seeds until crisp at the edges.

recipes.name: Dadpe Pohe
steps: Toss thin poha with chopped onion, fresh coconut, sugar, salt and lemon juice — no water, no cooking.
Press the mixture down firmly with the back of a bowl and leave it 10 minutes so the poha softens in the onion's moisture.
Pour over a hot tempering of mustard seeds, peanuts, slit green chillies, curry leaves and asafoetida.
Fluff with coriander and serve straight away while the tempering is still crackling.

recipes.name: Methi Muthiya
steps: Chop the methi fine, salt it and squeeze out the bitter water after 10 minutes.
Bind with besan, wheat flour, semolina, chilli-ginger paste, turmeric, sugar and a spoon of oil into a stiff dough — add water only if it will not come together.
Shape into thick cylinders and steam 20 minutes until a knife comes out clean.
Cool, slice into rounds and toss in a tempering of mustard, sesame seeds and curry leaves until the edges brown.

recipes.name: Sev Khamani
steps: Soak chana dal 5 hours, grind coarse with green chilli and a little water, then whisk in eno and steam into a firm khaman cake.
Cool and crumble the cake by hand into a coarse, fluffy mixture.
Fry a tempering of mustard, sesame, asafoetida and green chilli-garlic paste, add sugar and a splash of water and cook to a syrupy tadka.
Toss the crumbs through the tadka with lemon juice, then pile on nylon sev, coconut, pomegranate and coriander just before eating.

recipes.name: Locho
steps: Grind soaked chana and urad dal with green chilli to a loose batter and let it sour for 4 hours.
Whisk in turmeric, salt, oil and eno and steam in a greased tray — locho is deliberately under-set, it should collapse when scooped.
Scoop the soft mixture into a bowl while hot and mash a knob of butter through it.
Top with sev, raw onion, coriander, green chutney and a heavy dusting of chaat masala and red chilli powder.

recipes.name: Khichu
steps: Bring two cups of water to a rolling boil with cumin, sesame, chopped green chilli, papad khar and salt.
Tip in the rice flour all at once and beat hard with a wooden spoon until no dry flour remains.
Cover and steam on the lowest heat for 8 minutes, then mash the lump smooth while still hot.
Serve mounds of it in a bowl with raw groundnut oil poured over and a dusting of red chilli powder.

recipes.name: Radhaballabhi
steps: Soak urad dal 4 hours and grind coarse with ginger and green chilli, using as little water as possible.
Dry-fry the paste with hing, ground fennel and a little sugar until it stops sticking to the pan, then cool.
Make a soft maida dough with a moyan of oil and salt, rest 30 minutes, then stuff each ball with the dal filling and seal.
Roll gently into small discs — press from the centre outwards so the filling does not tear through.
Fry in hot oil, spooning oil over so they balloon, and serve with cholar dal or aloo dum.

recipes.name: Chirer Pulao
steps: Rinse thick chire quickly in a colander and leave it to drain so the flakes swell but do not turn mushy.
Fry coconut slivers, peanuts and cashews in ghee until golden and lift out.
In the same ghee temper bay leaf and whole garam masala, fry diced potato and peas, then add ginger paste, turmeric, sugar and salt.
Fold in the drained chire on low heat until every flake is coated and warm, then return the fried nuts and coconut and finish with a spoon of ghee.

recipes.name: Doi Chira
steps: Rinse the thick chire and drain it well, then leave it 5 minutes to soften.
Whisk sweet curd smooth with grated jaggery until the jaggery has dissolved completely.
Fold the curd through the chire with sliced banana and grated coconut.
Chill briefly and eat cold — this is a summer morning dish and should never be warm.

recipes.name: Gobi Paratha
steps: Grate the cauliflower, salt it and leave 10 minutes, then wring it dry in a cloth — wet filling is why gobi parathas tear.
Mix the dry gratings with green chilli, ginger, ajwain, amchur, chilli powder and coriander; do not cook the filling.
Roll a small disc of soft wheat dough, cup it, load the filling, gather the edges shut and flatten gently by hand before rolling.
Cook on a hot tawa, smearing butter on both sides, until dark brown blisters appear; serve with curd and pickle.

recipes.name: Paneer Paratha
steps: Grate the paneer fine and mash it with your palm until it is smooth and free of lumps.
Season with chopped onion, green chilli, crushed kasuri methi, chaat masala and salt — added only at the last moment so the onion does not weep.
Stuff into a rested wheat dough ball, seal the top and roll out with steady even pressure.
Cook on a medium tawa with ghee until both faces are golden and speckled; the paneer inside should stay soft, not squeaky.

recipes.name: Missi Roti
steps: Rub mustard oil into the besan and wheat flour so the gram flour loses its rawness when cooked.
Work in finely chopped onion, green chilli, ajwain, kasuri methi, turmeric and salt, then bind with just enough water to a stiff dough and rest 20 minutes.
Roll thicker than a chapati — besan dough cracks if pushed too thin — and cook on a hot tawa.
Press the edges with a cloth so it puffs, then finish directly over the flame for a second and smear with oil or ghee.

recipes.name: Punjabi Lassi
steps: Whisk chilled full-fat curd with sugar using a wooden madhani until the sugar dissolves and the curd loosens.
Churn hard for two full minutes so a thick head of foam builds — this froth is the whole point of a Punjabi lassi.
Thin with a little ice water to a pourable but heavy consistency and add crushed cardamom.
Pour into tall brass tumblers, spoon malai on top and dust with a pinch of cardamom before serving.

recipes.name: Bedmi Puri
steps: Soak urad dal 4 hours and grind it coarse and almost dry, then mix with crushed fennel, coriander seeds, hing, chilli powder and salt.
Knead the raw dal paste directly into wheat flour and semolina with a spoonful of oil into a tight dough and rest it 30 minutes.
Roll small thick puris and keep them covered so the surface does not dry.
Fry two at a time in very hot oil, pressing with the ladle until they balloon and turn deep brown; serve with aloo sabzi and pickle.

recipes.name: Matar Kulcha
steps: Soak dried white peas overnight and pressure cook them with salt and a pinch of soda until soft but still holding shape.
Mash a small ladleful of the peas back into the pot to thicken the liquid, then season with roasted cumin, black salt and chaat masala.
Ladle the matar into a bowl and top with raw onion, tomato, green chilli, ginger juliennes, tamarind chutney and lemon.
Split the kulchas, toast them on the tawa with butter until crisp at the edges, and serve alongside for scooping.

recipes.name: Chura Matar
steps: Coarsely crush fresh winter peas — they should stay chunky, not become a paste.
Warm plenty of ghee, temper cumin and grated ginger, then cook the crushed peas with a little sugar and salt until sweet and glossy.
Sprinkle water over the thick chura so it swells, then fold it in gently on the lowest heat.
Crumble khoya over the top, add fried cashews and a last spoon of ghee, cover for two minutes and serve steaming.

recipes.name: Daulat ki Chaat
steps: Boil the milk with cream and saffron, cool it, and leave it out overnight under the winter dew — the cold night air is what sets this dish.
Churn the chilled milk hard with a hand whisk at dawn, lifting off the foam into a wide tray as it forms.
Keep churning and collecting until you have a mountain of pale, weightless froth; it collapses within an hour so work fast.
Serve immediately in a leaf bowl dusted with powdered sugar, crumbled khoya and slivered pistachio.

recipes.name: Poori Bhaji
steps: Knead a tight wheat dough with a spoon of oil and salt using less water than for chapati, and rest it 15 minutes only.
Boil and roughly crush the potatoes, keeping some lumps for texture.
Temper mustard, curry leaves, green chilli and onion, add turmeric, then fold in the potatoes with a splash of water and simmer to a loose bhaji.
Roll small thick pooris and fry in hot oil, pressing once with the ladle so each puffs into a ball; serve straight from the kadhai.

recipes.name: Masala Omelette
steps: Beat the eggs with salt, turmeric and a pinch of chilli powder until frothy — the air is what keeps it fluffy.
Stir in finely chopped onion, tomato, green chilli and plenty of coriander.
Pour into a hot buttered pan, tilt to spread, and let the base set undisturbed before folding.
Cook 30 seconds more on the folded side and slide onto buttered toast.

recipes.name: Keema Paratha
steps: Brown onion in ghee, add ginger-garlic paste and the keema and fry on high heat until the mince separates and colours.
Season with chilli powder, garam masala and salt and cook uncovered until every drop of moisture has gone — wet keema will burst the paratha.
Cool the mince completely, then stuff it into rested wheat dough balls, seal and flatten by hand.
Roll carefully and cook on a hot tawa with ghee until both sides are crisp and mottled brown; serve with raw onion and lemon.

recipes.name: Paya Soup
steps: Scrub and singe the trotters, then blanch them once and discard the first water to remove the smell.
Pressure cook with whole garam masala, ginger-garlic and salt for at least an hour and a half until the collagen has melted and the broth turns sticky.
Separately brown sliced onions to a deep gold, grind to a paste with coriander powder and chilli, and stir into the broth.
Simmer another 30 minutes uncovered until the soup coats a spoon; finish with crushed pepper, ginger juliennes and coriander and drink it hot at dawn with khameeri roti.

recipes.name: Mirchi Vada
steps: Slit the big Rajasthani chillies lengthways and scrape out the seeds and membrane so they stay mild.
Mash boiled potato with crushed fennel, amchur, chilli powder, salt and coriander and pack it firmly into each chilli.
Whisk besan with ajwain, a pinch of soda and water into a thick coating batter.
Dip the stuffed chillies and fry in medium-hot oil till the besan crust is set and golden; serve pressed inside a bun with tamarind chutney.

recipes.name: Pyaz Kachori
steps: Make a maida dough with a heavy hand of oil as moyan so it stays short and flaky, and rest 30 minutes.
Fry the chopped onions with fennel, crushed coriander seeds, hing and chilli powder until they lose all water, then bind with besan and cook two minutes more.
Cool the filling, stuff into dough balls, seal and flatten gently to thick discs without rolling.
Fry very slowly in barely warm oil, raising the heat only at the end — a slow fry is what makes the shell blister and crack open.

recipes.name: Bajra Rotla
steps: Knead bajra flour with hot salted water into a warm dough and work it hard — millet has no gluten, so the kneading is what holds it together.
Pat each ball flat between your palms, turning constantly, into a thick disc; a rolling pin will only crack it.
Cook on a hot iron tawa until dark spots appear, then set it directly on the coals or flame until it puffs.
Smear generously with ghee and serve with jaggery, garlic chutney or a bowl of chaas.

recipes.name: Noon Chai
steps: Boil the green tea leaves with cardamom and a pinch of baking soda in a little water for 20 minutes until the liquor turns deep red.
Add ice-cold water and aerate the decoction by lifting it high with a ladle and pouring it back, again and again, until it darkens.
Strain, add hot milk and salt, and simmer — the soda plus the aeration is what turns it pink, not any colouring.
Pour into small cups, top with slivered pistachio and drink with girda or bakarkhani.

recipes.name: Kashmiri Bakarkhani
steps: Make a soft dough with maida, warm milk, sugar, salt and yeast and let it double.
Roll it out, smear generously with soft ghee, fold in three and roll again — repeat this laminating three times, chilling briefly between folds.
Cut into thick rounds, score the tops in a criss-cross, brush with milk and press sesame seeds all over.
Bake in a very hot oven or slap onto the walls of a tandoor until the layers separate and the surface is crisp and biscuity.

recipes.name: Dahi Bara Aloo Dum
steps: Grind soaked urad dal to a light fluffy batter, beat air into it, and fry small vadas until golden.
Drop the hot vadas into lightly salted spiced water so they soak and go pillowy, then squeeze gently and sit them in thin whisked curd.
Make the aloo dum separately — temper panch phoron, add tomato and onion paste with chilli powder, then simmer the boiled baby potatoes till the gravy clings.
To serve, ladle hot aloo dum and a spoon of ghuguni over the cold dahi bara and finish with raw onion, coriander and a heavy dusting of bhaja masala.

recipes.name: Chakuli Pitha
steps: Soak rice and biri dal separately for 5 hours, then grind them together to a batter slightly thicker than dosa batter.
Add grated coconut and salt and leave overnight to ferment till bubbly.
Pour a ladleful onto a hot greased tawa and spread only a little — chakuli is thick and soft, not crisp like dosa.
Cover and cook until the top sets and the base is pale gold, flip briefly, and eat with ghuguni or a coconut-jaggery mix.

recipes.name: Assamese Jolpan
steps: Soak the komal chaul in cold water for ten minutes — this Assamese rice needs no cooking at all, only soaking.
Drain and heap it into a bowl with a mound of thick curd.
Grate jaggery over the top and add sliced banana and a spoon of thick cream.
Mix at the table with your fingers and eat cold, with a piece of pitha alongside.

recipes.name: Ghila Pitha
steps: Melt the jaggery in a little warm water and strain out the grit.
Beat the sticky rice flour into the jaggery water with grated coconut and a pinch of salt to a thick dropping batter; rest it 20 minutes.
Heat mustard oil until it stops smoking, then drop spoonfuls of batter in — they should sink and rise back up.
Fry on medium heat until deep brown and puffed, drain well, and eat warm with red tea.

recipes.name: Sel Roti
steps: Soak the rice overnight, drain thoroughly and grind it with sugar, banana, cardamom and just enough milk to a thick, silky batter.
Beat in melted ghee and whip the batter by hand for several minutes until it ribbons off the ladle — under-beaten batter will not hold a ring.
Rest an hour, then pour the batter in a steady circular stream into hot oil to form a ring.
Turn once with a skewer and fry till reddish gold and crisp at the edges; lift out and drain standing upright.

recipes.name: Jadoh
steps: Render the diced pork belly in its own fat until the edges brown and the kitchen smells of crackling.
Add onion, ginger, turmeric, bay leaf, black pepper and salt and fry until the pork is well coated.
Stir in the washed rice so every grain takes on the fat and colour, then pour in water to one knuckle above the rice.
Cover and cook on the lowest heat until the rice is done and the pork is tender; rest ten minutes and fluff before serving with a chilli chutney.

recipes.name: Sattu Sharbat
steps: Whisk the sattu into a few spoons of chilled water first to a smooth paste so it never lumps.
Thin it out with the rest of the cold water, whisking continuously.
Season with black salt, roasted cumin, lemon juice and finely chopped green chilli and mint.
Serve immediately over ice — sattu settles fast, so stir again before each glass.

recipes.name: Dal Pitha
steps: Soak chana dal for 4 hours and grind it coarse with garlic, green chilli, ajwain and salt — the filling stays raw and grainy.
Cook rice flour with boiling salted water into a pliable dough and knead it while still hot.
Pinch off balls, hollow each into a cup with your thumb, fill with the dal paste and pinch shut into a half-moon.
Steam the pithas 15 minutes until the shells turn translucent, then eat hot with a drizzle of mustard oil and dhania-lehsun chutney.

recipes.name: Dal Pakwan
steps: Boil chana dal with turmeric and salt until just tender — the grains must stay whole and separate, not collapse into a mash.
Temper cumin, green chilli and red chilli powder in oil, pour over the dal, and finish with amchur and coriander.
Knead a stiff maida dough with ajwain, cumin and a heavy moyan of oil, roll into thin discs and prick all over with a fork so they stay flat.
Fry each pakwan on medium heat until pale gold and glass-crisp, then serve with the dal, tamarind chutney and raw onion.

recipes.name: Cilbir
steps: Beat the crushed garlic and a pinch of salt into room-temperature yogurt and spread it over a warm shallow bowl.
Bring a wide pan of water to a bare simmer with a splash of vinegar, swirl it and slide in the eggs one at a time.
Poach for three minutes until the whites are set and the yolks still loose, then lift out on a slotted spoon and drain.
Melt the butter until it foams and turns nutty, stir in the Aleppo pepper off the heat so it does not scorch.
Sit the eggs on the garlic yogurt, pour over the red butter and scatter with dill.

recipes.name: Simit
steps: Knead flour, yeast, salt and water into a firm dough and rest it covered for thirty minutes.
Divide into four, roll each piece into a long rope, fold it in half and twist the two strands together.
Join the ends into a ring, dip the ring in molasses thinned with a little water, then press it into a plate of sesame seeds.
Bake at 220C for eighteen to twenty minutes until deep bronze and the sesame smells toasted.
Cool briefly on a rack and eat warm with white cheese and tea.

recipes.name: Sucuklu Yumurta
steps: Lay the sucuk slices in a cold cast-iron pan and set it over medium heat so the spiced fat renders out slowly.
Fry for three to four minutes a side until the edges curl and the pan is slick with red fat.
Add the butter, then crack the eggs straight into the gaps between the slices.
Cover and cook two minutes until the whites are just set but the yolks run, grind over black pepper.
Bring the pan to the table and mop it with torn bread.

recipes.name: Bougatsa
steps: Heat the milk with the sugar, rain in the semolina and stir constantly until it thickens to a loose custard.
Take it off the heat, cool for five minutes, then beat in the eggs so they thicken the cream without scrambling.
Butter three filo sheets and layer them in a tin, pour in the custard and cover with three more buttered sheets.
Tuck the edges in, score the top and bake at 180C for thirty-five minutes until crisp and golden.
Rest ten minutes, cut into squares and dust heavily with icing sugar and cinnamon.

recipes.name: Tiropita
steps: Mash the feta with the ricotta, beat in the eggs, dill and plenty of black pepper — no salt, the feta carries it.
Brush a filo sheet with olive oil, cut it into long strips and spoon filling at one end of each.
Fold the strips into triangles, flag-style, keeping the remaining filo under a damp cloth.
Set them seam down on a tray, brush the tops with oil and bake at 190C for twenty-five minutes.
Serve hot enough that the cheese still pulls, with strong coffee.

recipes.name: Balaleet
steps: Toast the broken vermicelli in ghee until it turns the colour of straw, then boil it in salted water for four minutes and drain.
Return it to the pan with sugar, crushed cardamom, saffron steeped in a spoon of hot water and the rose water, and toss over low heat until glossy.
Beat the eggs with a pinch of salt and cook them flat in a buttered pan as a thin, barely coloured omelette.
Pile the sweet vermicelli on a plate and lay the omelette over it like a blanket.
Scatter with chopped pistachios and eat while the omelette is still warm against the cool sweetness.

recipes.name: Ijeh
steps: Chop the parsley and spring onion very fine — the batter should look more green than yellow.
Whisk the eggs with the flour, allspice, salt and pepper until smooth, then fold in the herbs.
Heat olive oil in a small pan and drop in ladlefuls to make thick little pancakes.
Fry two minutes a side over medium heat so the egg sets through before the herbs darken.
Drain on paper and serve warm with labneh, olives and a squeeze of lemon.

recipes.name: Labneh with Zaatar
steps: Spread the labneh across a shallow plate with the back of a spoon, leaving a swirl for the oil to pool in.
Pour the olive oil generously into the well and dust the surface with zaatar and a little sumac.
Set the olives alongside, warm the pita and tear it to scoop straight from the plate.

recipes.name: Pan con Tomate
steps: Toast or grill the bread hard on both sides so it is dry and rough enough to act as a grater.
Rub the cut face of the garlic clove once or twice across each hot slice.
Halve the tomatoes and rub them cut-side down until only the skins are left in your hand and the bread is soaked red.
Pour olive oil over in a thin stream and finish with flaky salt; eat straight away before it softens.

recipes.name: Huevos a la Flamenca
steps: Fry the chorizo in a shallow earthenware dish until its orange fat runs, then lift the slices out and set aside.
Soften the onion in that fat, add the tomatoes and smoked paprika and cook down to a thick sofrito.
Stir in the peas and strips of piquillo pepper, season, and spread the mixture level.
Make four wells, crack an egg into each and tuck the chorizo and torn ham around them.
Bake at 200C for ten to twelve minutes until the whites are set and the yolks still soft.

recipes.name: Bolo Levedo
steps: Warm the milk with the butter and sugar, then mix into the flour with the yeast, egg and a good pinch of salt.
Knead to a soft, slightly sticky dough and leave it to double, about an hour in a warm kitchen.
Divide into eight, flatten each into a disc about a centimetre thick and prove again for twenty minutes.
Cook on a dry griddle over low heat, six or seven minutes a side, so they colour in patches and cook through without burning.
Split while warm and load with butter — these are muffins from the Azores, not bread rolls.

recipes.name: Pain au Chocolat
steps: Roll the chilled laminated dough to four millimetres and cut it into rectangles roughly eight by twelve centimetres.
Lay a chocolate baton near one short edge, fold the dough over it, add a second baton and roll up so the seam ends underneath.
Set the rolls seam down on a buttered tray, well spaced, and prove at warm room temperature until visibly puffy and wobbly, about ninety minutes.
Brush with milk and bake at 200C for sixteen to eighteen minutes until the layers are dark amber and shatter when tapped.
Cool ten minutes so the chocolate thickens rather than runs out.

recipes.name: Pain Perdu
steps: Whisk the eggs, milk, sugar and vanilla into a smooth custard in a wide dish.
Lay the stale brioche in and leave it a full minute a side — day-old bread should drink the custard right to the middle.
Foam the butter in a heavy pan over medium-low heat and lay the slices in without crowding.
Fry three minutes a side until deep gold and the centre no longer wobbles.
Serve dusted with sugar, or with warm compote if you want it less plain.

recipes.name: Oeufs en Cocotte
steps: Butter four ramekins and spoon a tablespoon of cream into each with a scrape of nutmeg and a little salt.
Crack an egg into each ramekin, taking care not to break the yolk, and top with grated gruyere.
Stand the ramekins in a roasting tin and pour boiling water halfway up their sides.
Bake at 180C for ten to twelve minutes — pull them when the whites are just opaque, they carry on setting.
Scatter with chives and eat straight from the dish with fingers of toast.

recipes.name: Kaiserschmarrn
steps: Whisk the yolks with the milk, flour and a pinch of salt into a smooth batter and soak the raisins in it.
Beat the whites with the sugar to soft peaks and fold them through in two goes — this is what makes it fluffy rather than flat.
Pour into a hot buttered pan, cook until the underside is set and golden, then flip in one piece.
Once the second side colours, tear the pancake into rough pieces with two forks and let the torn edges caramelise in the butter.
Dust heavily with icing sugar and serve with plum compote on the side.

recipes.name: Bircher Muesli
steps: Soak the oats in the milk for at least an hour, or overnight in the fridge if you want them very soft.
Grate the whole apple, skin and all, straight into the lemon juice so it does not brown.
Fold the apple, yogurt and honey through the soaked oats until it is loose and spoonable, not stiff.
Top with toasted chopped hazelnuts and berries just before eating.

recipes.name: Weisswurst Breakfast
steps: Bring a pan of water to just below boiling and take it off the heat — weisswurst must never actually boil or the skins split.
Slide the sausages in and let them stand in the hot water for ten to twelve minutes until heated through.
Lift them out with tongs into a warmed bowl with a ladle of the water so they stay hot at the table.
Slit each skin lengthways and peel it back, or suck the sausage out of the casing as the Bavarians do.
Eat with sweet mustard and buttered pretzel, traditionally before midday.

recipes.name: Eggs Benedict
steps: Whisk the two yolks with the lemon juice over a bain-marie until pale and thick, then trickle in the warm melted butter to build a hollandaise; keep it barely warm.
Fry the bacon until the edges crisp and toast the split muffins.
Poach the whole eggs in simmering vinegared water for three minutes and drain them well on a cloth.
Build each half: muffin, bacon, poached egg, then a spoonful of hollandaise poured over so it slides down the sides.
Crack over black pepper and serve immediately — hollandaise waits for nobody.

recipes.name: Kedgeree
steps: Poach the haddock in milk or water for six minutes, then lift it out, discard skin and bones and flake it into big pieces.
Soften the onion in butter, stir in the curry powder and fry a minute until it smells toasted.
Add the washed rice, coat it in the spiced butter, pour in the measured poaching liquid and cook covered until absorbed.
Hard-boil the eggs for eight minutes, cool and quarter them.
Fold the flaked fish through the hot rice off the heat, top with the eggs, parsley and a hard squeeze of lemon.

recipes.name: Bubble and Squeak
steps: Fry the onion in butter until soft and lightly browned at the edges.
Mix in the cold mash and cabbage, season hard with salt and pepper, and press the lot flat into the pan.
Leave it alone over medium heat for eight minutes so a proper brown crust forms underneath — the squeak is the cabbage in the hot fat.
Flip in sections with a fish slice, add a little more butter and crust the second side.
Serve in wedges with brown sauce, or alongside cold roast leftovers.

recipes.name: Welsh Rarebit
steps: Melt the butter, stir in the flour and cook one minute, then whisk in the milk to a thick paste.
Take off the heat and beat in the cheese, mustard and cayenne until it becomes a stiff, glossy mixture.
Toast the bread on both sides so it can carry the topping without going soggy.
Spread the cheese mixture thickly right to the edges and blister it under a hot grill for three minutes until bubbling and freckled brown.

recipes.name: Ulster Fry
steps: Start the sausages in a cold pan over low heat and let them cook slowly for fifteen minutes, turning, so they brown without bursting.
Add the bacon and black pudding to the same pan and cook until the bacon fat is crisp and the pudding has a crust.
